paper_title: Resonant detection of axion mediated forces with Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
notes: Projection paper proposing an NMR-based resonant detection of axion-mediated spin-dependent forces. Fig. 2 shows monopole-dipole reach (|gs^N gp^N| vs force range/fa), which corresponds to MonopoleDipole coupling. Fig. 3 shows dipole-dipole reach (g_pN^2 and g_pN g_pe), corresponding to AxionNeutron/AxionElectron. The primary x-axis is force range (cm) / fa (GeV) and mass range is 1e-6 to 1e-3 eV. No numerical table of (mass, coupling) limit points is provided; only plot curves. Could not extract reliable numerical data points from the figures. | Vision: Figure 2 monopole-dipole plot. X-axis is force range in cm (0.003-10 cm), converted to axion mass via m_a=hbar*c/lambda with hbar*c=1.973e-5 eV*cm. The reported boundary traces the LOWER edge of the existing combined 'Astrophysical and Experimental Bounds' shaded region (the actual exclusion). Y-axis is |g_s^N g_p^N|. The red/blue lines are projected sensitivities (not exclusions). Note larger force range = smaller mass, so points span from ~6e-3 eV (small range) down to ~2e-6 eV (10 cm range). Readings approximate due to log-scale plot extraction. | Calibration: No calibration needed
